Report Output Options and Export Formats

features.name: Detailed Trial Balance Report
features.description: A report showing balance information and detailed transactions posted to each GL account. Allows filtering to specific accounts or ranges of accounts, with option to print each account on a new page.

features.name: Summary Trial Balance Report
features.description: A summary report that compares values from the current year to prior year or configured budgets. Supports displaying variance as a percentage and rounding options.
caveats: Requires budgets to be configured in Business Central for budget comparison

features.name: Aged Accounts Receivable Report
features.description: An aging report for customers showing aged information by transaction date or due date. Allows filtering to specific customer classes and viewing overdue balances.

features.name: Aged Accounts Payable Report
features.description: An aging report for vendors showing aged payables information. Available alongside the AR aging report in Business Central.

features.name: Report Export to Excel
features.description: Ability to export reports including aging and trial balance reports to Excel format for additional analysis and creating visuals.

features.name: Report Export to PDF or Word
features.description: Ability to send reports to PDF or Word formats for distribution and sharing.
